name: Depth's Revival
source: You play as a college student that awakens his subconscious in order to change his life. With his subconscious help, he can become the man he always wanted to become. So go ahead and try to make your Dream's come true.​
translation: 你扮演一名大学生，唤醒他的潜意识以改变他的生活。在潜意识的帮助下，他可以成为他一直想成为的人。所以，继续努力，让你的梦想成真。​
